subject: Social Media
title: Clickbait Science
description: A quick win: understand Clickbait Science.

hook.text: 'You won't believe what happened next.' Your brain can't resist. That's a curiosity gap.

buildup.text: Loewenstein's gap theory: when you sense missing info, your brain demands closure at any cost.

discovery.text: Clickbait exploits this by creating artificial gaps. The headline promises; the content underdelivers.

twist.text: Platforms fought back by tracking bounce rate. Click but leave fast? The content gets penalized.

climax.text: Modern clickbait adapted. It delivers just enough to dodge penalties while still exploiting you.

quiz.question: What psychological mechanism does clickbait exploit?
